.husky/pre-commit.local.IMPLICIT: a commit staging the library, its bundle or a log runs that file's validator and is refused on any fault it prints: data/gallery.json, data/styles.json or images/ run `node validate.js --staged`; data/gallery.json, data/styles.json or data/vault-data.js run `node bundle.js --staged`, refusing a bundle that does not match the staged JSON (#32); data/round-log.jsonl runs `node round-log.js --staged` (#95), data/corrections-log.jsonl `node corrections-log.js --staged` (#166) and data/calibration-log.jsonl `node calibration-log.js --staged` (#168), each refusing a malformed row, a change to a committed row beyond adding its final_pick (round log) or answering its pending ruling (corrections log), a calibration run whose figures disagree with the disagreements listed under it, or a git it cannot read.
.husky/pre-commit.local.JUSTIFIED: fail-safe — a malformed library entry travels into every brief copied from it, a stale bundle shows the page a version behind with nothing saying so, and the logs hold the founder's first picks, his corrections in his own words and the critic's calibration figures, none of which can be recovered once rewritten; the commit is the last local moment to catch each (lucmoseley/mantahostels#3631 step 2).
.husky/pre-commit.local.DEFEAT: none — fix the fault the validator names, run node bundle.js and commit data/vault-data.js with the JSON, or append a new log row; a commit that touches none of these paths runs none of them.
